what_was_already_seen: benchmarks/core_gap_thin_ridge: a first adversarial family of 402 cases (seed 20260913) on which aliasing threshold 18.42 had 28 thin-rule false positives and 9.21 had 6, found post hoc
the real grids TCR wide/narrow, Battery P2/P3, K2 MULTI/WEAK_C2 and F5, whose aliasing numbers were reported there

diagnostic.definition: A = min over non-zero integer vectors n of (2 pi)^2 n^T S n, with S the local covariance fitted to the grid's own log-likelihood in LATTICE UNITS (coordinates divided by each axis's step), found exactly by Fincke-Pohst enumeration
diagnostic.implementation: src/engcore/inference/calibration.py, private; the validation calls the same functions the guard calls
companion_refusals_not_threshold_bearing: local curvature cannot be fitted or is not concave

materiality_declared_now: a grid is MATERIALLY WRONG when, against its trusted reference, a marginal mean is off by more than 0.1 true sd, or a marginal sd ratio leaves [0.9, 1.1], or the sd along the TRUE thinnest principal direction leaves [0.9, 1.1], or the mean along it is off by more than 0.1 of its sd

candidate_thresholds.why_a_ladder: a decade in aliasing amplitude exp(-A/2) is the natural resolution of the quantity; choosing among declared rungs cannot tune a decimal to the data

HELD_BACK_SYNTHETIC.disjoint_from_first_family: no correlation, width, angle, density, window or scale value below was used in benchmarks/core_gap_thin_ridge

2D_scaling_consistent.grid: window scaled with the parameter (units only)

HELD_BACK_SYNTHETIC.truth: exact: every target is a Gaussian embedded as admitted linear observations; windows are at least 5 marginal sd so truncation is below 1e-6 in mass

selection_rule: (i) every case that is materially wrong against a trusted reference must be refused at T: A < T, or a companion refusal fires
(ii) every REAL case confirmed healthy against its trusted reference must be kept: A >= T and no companion refusal
(iii) on HELD_BACK_SYNTHETIC cases that are healthy, at most 10 % may be refused
choose the LARGEST ladder value satisfying (i), (ii) and (iii): the most conservative threshold that keeps what must be kept
if no ladder value satisfies all three, the repair is BLOCKED and no threshold is committed
